pinyin: tiě lù jǐng chá —— gè guǎn yī duàn
literal: railway · police — each · manage · one · section
natural: Railway police each patrol their own stretch

meaning.en: Everyone minds only their own area and ignores the rest.
meaning.zh: 铁路警察各管自己的一段，比喻各人只管自己分内的事，互不过问。

examples.zh: 这个部门铁路警察，各管一段，没人负责全局。
examples.en: In this department each person minds their own patch and no one oversees the whole.

examples.zh: 你们别铁路警察各管一段，要互相配合。
examples.en: Don't just stay in your own lanes; cooperate.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Often a mild criticism of lack of coordination.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常含批评缺乏协作之意。

text: 铁杵磨绣针——非一日之功
pinyin: tiě chǔ mó xiù zhēn —— fēi yī rì zhī gōng
variants: 铁杵磨成针——功到自然成
literal: iron · pestle · grind · embroidery needle — not · one · day · 's · effort
natural: Grinding an iron pestle into a needle takes time

meaning.zh: 把铁杵磨成针需要很长时间，比喻只要坚持，终能成功，但不是一天能做到的。

equivalents: Rome wasn't built in a day

examples.zh: 学外语就像铁杵磨绣针，非一日之功。
examples.en: Learning a language takes time and perseverance.

examples.zh: 铁杵磨绣针，别着急，慢慢来。
examples.en: Don't rush; take it slowly.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Cf. the Li Bai legend of the old woman grinding an iron pestle (铁杵磨成针).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。参见李白遇老妪磨铁杵的传说。

pinyin: tiào xià huáng hé —— xǐ bù qīng
literal: jump · into · Yellow River — wash · not · clean
natural: Jump into the Yellow River and still not wash clean

meaning.en: Unable to clear one's name, however much one tries.
meaning.zh: 黄河水浑，跳进去也洗不干净，比喻无法证明自己清白。

examples.zh: 这件事他跳下黄河都洗不清。
examples.en: He couldn't clear his name even if he tried.

examples.zh: 跳下黄河——洗不清，大家都认定是他干的。
examples.en: Everyone is convinced he did it, and there's no way to prove otherwise.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The phrase is often 跳进黄河也洗不清.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常说“跳进黄河也洗不清”。

pinyin: shuāng dǎ qié zi —— ruǎn bù lā dā
literal: frost · hit · aubergine — limp · not · droop

meaning.zh: 茄子被霜打后蔫了，比喻人没精神、萎靡不振。

examples.zh: 他今天霜打茄子，软不拉耷的。
examples.en: He seems limp and listless today.

examples.zh: 一听成绩不好，大家都霜打茄子似的。
examples.en: On hearing the poor results, everyone drooped.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Another common version is 霜打的茄子——蔫了.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。另一常见说法是“霜打的茄子——蔫了”。

text: 石膏点豆腐——一物降一物
pinyin: shí gāo diǎn dòu fu —— yī wù xiáng yī wù
literal: gypsum · coagulate · tofu — one · thing · subdue · one · thing

meaning.en: Everything has something that keeps it in check.
meaning.zh: 石膏能使豆浆凝固成豆腐，比喻每样东西都有制服它的东西。

examples.zh: 他怕老婆，石膏点豆腐，一物降一物。
examples.en: He's afraid of his wife; everything has its master.

examples.zh: 这孩子谁都不怕，就怕爷爷，真是石膏点豆腐。
examples.en: The child fears nobody but Grandpa.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The second half also stands alone as a proverb.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句“一物降一物”也可单独成语。

text: 生米煮成了熟饭——改不过来
pinyin: shēng mǐ zhǔ chéng le shú fàn —— gǎi bù guò lái
variants: 生米煮成熟饭——已成事实
literal: raw · rice · cook · become · le · cooked · rice — change · not · over
natural: Raw rice has become cooked rice

meaning.en: What is done cannot be undone.
meaning.zh: 生米煮成熟饭就不能再变回去，比喻事情已成定局，无法更改。

examples.zh: 生米煮成了熟饭，现在后悔也晚了。
examples.en: What's done is done; it's too late for regrets.

examples.zh: 既然生米煮成了熟饭，就只好接受。
examples.en: Since it's a fait accompli, we have to accept it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Also said 生米做成熟饭, and used of marriages arranged by a fait accompli.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也说“生米做成熟饭”。

pinyin: shàng fáng chāi tī zi —— bù liú hòu lù
literal: up · roof · remove · ladder — not · leave · back · road
natural: Climb onto the roof and remove the ladder

meaning.en: To cut off someone's retreat, or one's own.
meaning.zh: 上了房顶就把梯子拆掉，比喻断绝别人（或自己）的退路。

examples.zh: 你这是上房拆梯子，不留后路。
examples.en: You're burning your bridges.

examples.zh: 他上房拆梯子，把我们都困住了。
examples.en: He has left us with no way out.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Can also mean 'abandon those who helped you', like 过河拆桥.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也可指过河拆桥。

text: 沙锅里捣蒜——一锤子买卖
pinyin: shā guō lǐ dǎo suàn —— yī chuí zi mǎi mài
variants: 砂锅里捣蒜——一锤子买卖
literal: earthenware pot · in · pound · garlic — one · hammer · trade
natural: Pounding garlic in a clay pot breaks it in one blow

meaning.en: A one-off transaction with no thought for the future.
meaning.zh: 砂锅里捣蒜，一锤下去就破了，比喻只做一次买卖，不考虑长远。

examples.zh: 沙锅里捣蒜，一锤子买卖，他根本不在乎回头客。
examples.en: He has no thought for repeat customers.

examples.zh: 做生意别沙锅里捣蒜，要考虑长远。
examples.en: Don't run a business for a one-off profit; think long-term.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Also written 砂锅里捣蒜; 一锤子买卖 is often used alone.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也作“砂锅里捣蒜”，“一锤子买卖”常单用。

text: 人到矮檐下——不得不低头
pinyin: rén dào ǎi yán xià —— bù dé bù dī tóu
literal: person · reach · low · eaves · under — not · obtain · not · lower · head
natural: Under a low roof, one must bow

meaning.en: When one is at someone else's mercy, one has to submit.
meaning.zh: 人到了矮屋檐下，不得不低头，比喻处于别人势力范围内，只好屈服。

examples.zh: 人到矮檐下，不得不低头，我只能先答应。
examples.en: I have no choice but to agree.

examples.zh: 他人到矮檐下，不得不低头。
examples.en: Under someone else's roof, he had to yield.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From the proverb 人在屋檐下，不得不低头.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。源于俗语“人在屋檐下，不得不低头”。

text: 碰到南墙不回头——死心眼
pinyin: pèng dào nán qiáng bù huí tóu —— sǐ xīn yan
literal: bump · against · south · wall · not · turn · head — dead · heart · eye
natural: Hit the south wall and still not turn back

meaning.en: Stubborn to the point of never changing course.
meaning.zh: 撞到南墙也不回头，比喻固执己见，不撞到绝路不改变。

equivalents: won't take no for an answer

examples.zh: 他碰到南墙不回头，死心眼，劝也没用。
examples.en: He's stubborn and nothing you say helps.

examples.zh: 别碰到南墙不回头，换个思路吧。
examples.en: Don't keep banging your head; try another approach.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Often 不撞南墙不回头 ('won't turn back till hitting the wall').
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常说“不撞南墙不回头”。

text: 拍马屁拍到蹄子上——倒挨一脚
pinyin: pāi mǎ pì pāi dào tí zi shàng —— dào āi yī jiǎo
literal: pat · horse · rump · pat · onto · hoof — instead · suffer · one · kick
natural: Patting the horse's rump but hitting the hoof

meaning.en: Flattery that backfires and brings a rebuke.
meaning.zh: 拍马屁拍到马蹄上，反被踢一脚，比喻奉承不当反而招来不快。

examples.zh: 他拍马屁拍到蹄子上，倒挨一脚。
examples.en: His flattery backfired and he got rebuked.

examples.zh: 奉承要看场合，别拍马屁拍到蹄子上。
examples.en: Mind where you flatter, or it will backfire.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Also said 马屁拍到马腿上.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也说“马屁拍到马腿上”。

pinyin: mǎ fēng wō —— tǒng bù dé
natural: A hornet's nest, not to be poked

meaning.en: Something dangerous to stir up; a person or issue best left alone.
meaning.zh: 马蜂窝一捅就会被蜇，比喻不能招惹的人或事。

examples.zh: 那个人是马蜂窝，捅不得。
examples.en: That man's a hornet's nest; don't provoke him.

examples.zh: 这件旧案是马蜂窝——捅不得。
examples.en: That old case is best left alone.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The English idiom 'stir up a hornet's nest' mirrors it (捅马蜂窝).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。汉语也说“捅马蜂窝”。

pinyin: liú chán lè bù sī shǔ —— wàng běn
literal: Liu Shan · happy · not · think · Shu — forget · root
natural: Liu Shan so happy he forgets Shu

meaning.en: To forget one's roots or homeland while enjoying a comfortable life elsewhere.
meaning.zh: 刘禅降魏后说此间乐，不思蜀，比喻乐而忘本。

examples.zh: 他到了大城市就刘禅乐不思蜀，忘了老家。
examples.en: In the big city he forgot his hometown.

examples.zh: 刘禅乐不思蜀——忘本，这样的人不可靠。
examples.en: One who forgets his roots is not reliable.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. 乐不思蜀 is a chengyu from the Three Kingdoms.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“乐不思蜀”本身是成语，出自三国故事。

text: 癞痢头撑伞——无法（发）无天
pinyin: lài lì tóu chēng sǎn —— wú fǎ (fà) wú tiān
literal: scabby head · hold · umbrella — no · law (hair) · no · sky
natural: A bald man with an umbrella: no hair, no sky

meaning.en: Lawless and wild. Pun: 发 (fà, hair) and 法 (fǎ, law).
meaning.zh: 癞痢头没头发，撑伞又遮天，谐音“无法（发）无天”，比喻肆无忌惮、不守法纪。

examples.zh: 他癞痢头撑伞，无法无天，什么都敢干。
examples.en: He's lawless and dares to do anything.

examples.zh: 这帮人癞痢头撑伞——无法（发）无天。
examples.en: The gang flouts all rules.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 发 (hair) and 法 (law) sound alike; 无法无天 is a four-character chengyu.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。谐音双关：“发”与“法”近音。

text: 看戏的掉眼泪——替古人担忧
pinyin: kàn xì de diào yǎn lèi —— tì gǔ rén dān yōu
literal: watch · opera · de · drop · tears — for · ancients · worry
natural: Weeping at the theatre and worrying for people of long ago

meaning.en: Worrying needlessly about matters that don't concern you.
meaning.zh: 看戏流泪是为戏中古人担忧，比喻替别人或不相干的事操心。

equivalents: worry about something that doesn't concern you

examples.zh: 看戏的掉眼泪，替古人担忧，你瞎操什么心。
examples.en: Why worry about what doesn't concern you?

examples.zh: 别看戏的掉眼泪了，这事和你无关。
examples.en: Don't fret; it has nothing to do with you.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The 古人 are the characters in the play.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“古人”指戏中人物。

text: 瞌睡碰着枕头——求之不得
pinyin: kē shuì pèng zháo zhěn tou —— qiú zhī bù dé
literal: sleepy · meet · pillow — seek · it · not · get
natural: A sleepy person meets a pillow

meaning.en: Exactly what one wanted; a welcome opportunity.
meaning.zh: 瞌睡时碰到枕头，正是所需，比喻正中下怀、求之不得。

examples.zh: 你要我帮忙？瞌睡碰着枕头，求之不得。
examples.en: You want my help? That's just what I hoped for.

examples.zh: 这个机会对他是瞌睡碰着枕头。
examples.en: The opportunity was a godsend for him.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. 求之不得 is a chengyu on its own.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句“求之不得”本身是成语。

text: 敬酒不吃吃罚酒——不知好歹
pinyin: jìng jiǔ bù chī chī fá jiǔ —— bù zhī hǎo dǎi
literal: toast · wine · not · drink · drink · penalty · wine — not · know · good · bad
natural: Declining the toast and drinking the forfeit

meaning.en: To refuse a courteous offer and so suffer worse; not knowing what is good for one.
meaning.zh: 好言相劝不听，非要受罚，比喻不接受好意而自讨苦吃。

equivalents: refuse the carrot and get the stick
not know what's good for one

examples.zh: 他敬酒不吃吃罚酒，最后被罚了款。
examples.en: He refused the offer and ended up fined.

examples.zh: 别敬酒不吃吃罚酒，赶紧答应吧。
examples.en: Don't push your luck; just say yes.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Often used as a warning.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常用作警告。

pinyin: jiǎo zi tuō pí —— lù le xiàn
literal: dumpling · shed · skin — show · le · filling
natural: A dumpling loses its skin and the filling shows

meaning.en: The truth is revealed; a secret comes out.
meaning.zh: 饺子皮破了馅就露出来，比喻真相暴露、秘密泄露。

equivalents: the cat's out of the bag

examples.zh: 他撒谎被揭穿，饺子脱皮，露了馅。
examples.en: His lie was exposed.

examples.zh: 饺子脱皮——露了馅，再也瞒不住了。
examples.en: The secret is out and cannot be hidden.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. 露馅 is also a common casual verb phrase.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。“露馅”也常单用。

text: 急惊风碰着个慢郎中——干着急
pinyin: jí jīng fēng pèng zhe gè màn láng zhōng —— gān zháo jí
literal: acute · convulsion · meet · a · slow · doctor — dry · worry
natural: Acute convulsions meet a slow doctor

meaning.en: An urgent matter put in slow hands; being impatient while someone dawdles.
meaning.zh: 孩子得急病，遇上做事慢的医生，只能干着急，比喻急事遇上慢性子。

examples.zh: 真是急惊风碰着个慢郎中，我急得团团转，他却不慌不忙。
examples.en: I was frantic while he stayed calm; impatience meets slowness.

examples.zh: 急惊风碰着个慢郎中——干着急。
examples.en: An urgent person meets a slow one.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Also said 急惊风遇着慢郎中.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。也说“急惊风遇着慢郎中”。
